verdict.rationale: Factory documents approval mechanisms (tiered autonomy, diff review before merge, inline approvals in Droid CLI/App) that let a PM review and approve agent actions, and sessions can be monitored/managed remotely via the Factory App (web or desktop) [factory-docs-1, factory-docs-7, factory-docs-15, factory-docs-18]. However, there is no evidence of a phone/mobile-specific interface — the App is described only as web/desktop, with no mobile app or push-approval workflow mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit mobile/phone app support, on-the-go approval notifications, and confirmation that agents continue autonomously while awaiting remote approval.
